firstPlayerRule: The player carrying the highest value of actual cash becomes the first Sheriff.
officialTieBreak: If there is a tie or nobody has money, choose the first Sheriff randomly.
clarifications: The Sheriff does not participate in the Market phase; the merchant to the Sheriff’s left acts first, then play proceeds clockwise. The Sheriff marker passes left after each round.
